A is the correct distribution. Kathy takes the condominium by survivorship under the tenancy-by-the-entirety deed, a completed lifetime conveyance, so Julie’s devise of that property is adeemed. The prenuptial agreement waives Kathy’s pretermitted-spouse, elective-share, and other statutory marital claims, so Tommy takes the pasture land under the will and Tommy and Julie split the residue.

CONFIDENCE: 86
